nodes.label: Greedy Debt Simplification Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Minimizes number of transactions needed to settle a group by using a greedy algorithm on creditor/debtor queues. Chosen for O(n) simplicity over optimal solutions.

nodes.label: Double-Entry Wallet Ledger
nodes.rationale: WalletTransaction table is the source of truth; wallet_balance on User is a denormalized cache only. Enables drift detection and full audit trail.

nodes.label: @idempotent Decorator (SHA-256 body hashing)
nodes.rationale: Protects all payment endpoints from duplicate execution. Uses DB-level UNIQUE constraint as the safety net for concurrent races.

nodes.label: Pessimistic Row-Level Locking (Sorted UUID Order)
nodes.rationale: SELECT FOR UPDATE with sorted UUID lock acquisition prevents deadlocks by construction. Chosen over optimistic locking because financial correctness is paramount.

nodes.label: useAutoRefresh Polling Hook
nodes.rationale: Deliberate simplicity — polling over WebSockets. Reduces infrastructure complexity while providing adequate real-time feel for financial settlement use cases.

nodes.label: SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod) Strategy
nodes.rationale: SQLite used by default for zero-config local development; DATABASE_URL env var switches to PostgreSQL for production. Speeds up onboarding but creates SQLite/PG parity gaps in concurrency testing.

nodes.label: SQLite-backed CI Test Suite
nodes.rationale: CI runs SQLite tests without a Postgres service container to simplify the CI setup. PG-specific tests are skipped automatically until a second job with a service container is added.

nodes.label: TC-1: Idempotency Race Condition (Double Spend)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL: Two concurrent requests with same idempotency key both pass SELECT check before either commits. Fix: UniqueConstraint on (key, user_id, endpoint).

nodes.label: TC-2: Stripe request Variable Shadowing Bug
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL: Local 'request' variable shadows FastAPI Request param in stripe_routes.py, breaking Stripe idempotency key forwarding and enabling duplicate charges.
nodes.norm_label: tc-2: stripe request variable shadowing bug

nodes.label: TC-6: PaymentRequest TOCTOU (Status Checked Before Lock)
nodes.rationale: HIGH: PaymentRequest status checked before row lock acquired. Fix: re-fetch PaymentRequest with FOR UPDATE after acquiring user locks.
nodes.norm_label: tc-6: paymentrequest toctou (status checked before lock)

nodes.label: TC-9: Float Used for Money (Rounding Drift)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL: Float arithmetic accumulates rounding errors over time. Fix: migrate all monetary columns to Numeric(12,2) and use Decimal throughout.
nodes.norm_label: tc-9: float used for money (rounding drift)

nodes.label: TC-7: Admin Endpoints Unauthenticated
nodes.rationale: HIGH: /api/admin/reconciliation endpoints had no authentication, exposing PII and balance manipulation. Fix: add get_current_user dependency.

nodes.label: Idempotency Infrastructure Redesign
nodes.rationale: UniqueConstraint is the database-level safety net. Application-level SELECT before INSERT is for performance only; correctness requires the DB constraint under MVCC.

nodes.label: Sorted-Order Row Lock Strategy (Deadlock Prevention)
nodes.rationale: Prevents deadlocks by construction rather than detection/recovery. All requesters sort by user UUID before acquiring locks, ensuring consistent acquisition order.

nodes.label: 9-Step Payment Protocol (TOCTOU Fix)
nodes.rationale: Step 3.5 re-fetches PaymentRequest with FOR UPDATE after acquiring user locks, closing the TOCTOU window between initial status check and lock acquisition.

nodes.label: Double-Entry Ledger Design
nodes.rationale: wallet_balance is a cache; WalletTransaction table is source of truth. pre_validate_balance and validate_balance_integrity enforce invariant before and after mutations.

nodes.label: Float to Numeric(12,2) Decimal Precision Upgrade
nodes.norm_label: float to numeric(12,2) decimal precision upgrade

nodes.label: Stage 1: Sequential SQLite Tests
nodes.rationale: Prove logic correctness but cannot validate concurrency safety. FOR UPDATE is no-op on SQLite; race conditions impossible to trigger sequentially.

nodes.label: Stage 2: PostgreSQL Concurrency Tests (asyncio.gather)
nodes.rationale: True parallelism proves row-level locks actually block, UniqueConstraint races actually fire, and wallet drain never goes negative.

nodes.label: Stage 3: Failure Injection Tests
nodes.rationale: Proves crash-after-commit returns cached response, partial failures result in complete rollback, retry storms cannot penetrate idempotency barrier.

nodes.label: Conservation of Money Invariant
nodes.rationale: assert_conservation_of_money checks total_before == total_after for every transfer. Invariant-based testing catches classes of bugs rather than specific values.

nodes.label: Flush vs Commit Pattern
nodes.rationale: db.flush() writes SQL within the transaction; db.commit() makes it permanent. Exception after flush but before commit results in complete rollback. Enables write-invariant-check-commit atomic pattern.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Service (Safety Net)
nodes.rationale: Exists as a safety net; invariant checks should prevent drift entirely. If reconciliation finds a discrepancy, it signals a bug in transaction logic requiring investigation.

nodes.label: Interac e-Transfer Canadian Market Wedge
nodes.rationale: Splitwise/Venmo lack Interac support; 70% of millennials/GenZ split costs. Canadian users need Interac as Venmo/Zelle are unavailable in Canada.

nodes.label: Numeric(12,2) Monetary Column Convention
nodes.rationale: All monetary columns use Numeric(12,2,asdecimal=True) — exact decimal, no floats. All PKs are UUIDs. Prevents float drift that caused audit TC-9.
